999008199.text:
ごきげんよう。
あなた、何を企んでいますの？

localizations.en: Good day. What exactly are you scheming?

999008199.text: あら、なんのことかしら？

localizations.en: Oh my, whatever do you mean?

999008199.text:
とぼけないでくださる？　ララ・キングダムの
不利益になることじゃないですわよね？

localizations.en: Please don't play dumb with me. This isn't going to be detrimental to the Kingdom of Lara, is it?

999008199.text: もちろんよ。そんなことはしないわ

localizations.en: Of course not. I wouldn't do such a thing.

999008199.text: まったく。また牢へ逆戻りになりますわよ

localizations.en: Honestly. You'll end up back in prison at this rate.

999008199.text: 違法なことはしないわ
そういう人は違法スレスレなこともしないものですのよ

localizations.en: People who say that also don't do things that skirt the edge of legality.

999008199.text:
それはつまらないじゃない。
大丈夫よ。私は上手くやる

localizations.en: Now that would be boring, wouldn't it? Don't worry. I know what I'm doing.

999008199.text: 久々の自由を十二分に楽しんでみせるわ

localizations.en: I'm going to enjoy my freedom to the fullest for the first time in ages.
